name: da_test_scenarios_sprint2
description: 15 test scenarios (TC-P-001..005, TC-C-001..005, TC-B-001..005) authored independently by the Data Analyst (Laplace_Data Analyst.pdf, Sprint 2 'Finalize Test Scenarios' deliverable), converted into AgentGate's ActionRequest schema. This is the first eval data in the repo NOT authored by whoever wrote the detectors - closes the 'DS grading its own homework' gap flagged in eval_set.json.
_conversion_note: The source document uses its own ad-hoc ActionRequest-like JSON shape (query_filter, affected_items, recipient, etc.) rather than AgentGate's real schema. Each case below is a best-effort mapping into real ActionRequest fields, preserving the DA's original payload facts (amounts, counts, recipients) in payload_summary/content_context. action_type is mapped to AgentGate's actual action vocabulary since the DA's own action_type strings (BULK_MODIFY, EXTERNAL_SEND, etc.) aren't part of it. Expected decisions are the DA's, unmodified - where AgentGate's real output disagrees, that's a genuine finding, not a data error to be quietly fixed here.
